05 / GOOD QUESTIONS

Clear answers.
From the start.

What is AI search optimization?

It is the work of making your website accessible, accurate, and useful for search experiences that use AI. GrowthSignal combines website checks, content improvements, and sampled answer monitoring to help you decide what to work on.

Can GrowthSignal guarantee I appear in ChatGPT?

No. Recommendations depend on the query, platform, location, available sources, and other factors. We help improve your website’s foundation and report what we observe without promising placement.

Is this different from traditional SEO?

There is substantial overlap. Clear content, accessible pages, accurate business information, and good website structure matter in both. GrowthSignal adds an AI search focused workflow and transparent answer samples.

Do I need to connect my website to get started?

A public website URL is enough for an initial scan. Applying changes requires access to your website or help from your webmaster. Installation support depends on your website platform.

What do the AI answer samples tell me?

They show whether your business was mentioned or cited in a specific set of test answers. They are snapshots, not a universal ranking. API samples may differ from what an individual user sees in a consumer app.

Can I run a live audit or subscribe today?

This site is a launch preview. You can explore a sample report and compare the planned tiers. Live scanning, accounts, and billing are not available yet. You can send an inquiry below to ask questions or express interest.
